entries.what: Labor Day off from the swing shift. Noemi sleeps in, then helps Iris pack a picnic for Delgado Park and later fixes her parents' printer in the Vinca fourplex.
entries.outcome: Printer working again, a lazy holiday.

entries.what: Evening of co-op survival game with her squad as packetloss_ after dinner at home.
entries.outcome: Squad cleared the base build.

entries.what: Drives to Ruel Road for the 2 p.m. swing shift and meets new hire Bao Tran at the IT cage, walking him through the repair bench.
entries.outcome: Bao is set up with a badge and bench spot.

entries.what: First Tuesday 3-5 p.m. training block: Bao swaps scanner batteries and trigger boards under her watch.
entries.outcome: Bao swapped four batteries, not ready for reimaging.

entries.what: Handles night-shift handoff tickets and updates the RMA sheet with dead scanners from the cage.
entries.outcome: Six scanners queued for vendor return.

entries.what: Starts the day sleeping until 9, then stops at the Ruel Road station to fill up and sees the check-engine light come on.
entries.outcome: Suspects the O2 sensor and plans to get it checked.

entries.what: Swing shift at the help desk fixing frozen laptops and a badge reader that keeps rejecting night pickers.
entries.outcome: Carla's dead scanner escalation resolved with a swap.

entries.what: Tells Iris about the car light over late dinner of leftover rice bowls.
entries.outcome: Iris says to get a quote before the weekend.

entries.what: Prepping for Bao's Thursday session, she asks her assistant for a simple analogy to explain scanner Wi-Fi roaming.
entries.outcome: Settles on a cell-phone handoff-between-towers analogy.

entries.what: Thursday 3-5 p.m. training: she explains roaming to Bao using the analogy, then he repairs two trigger boards.
entries.outcome: Bao gets it and fixes both scanners.

entries.what: Thursday sushi night at home with Iris.
entries.outcome: Quiet evening, split the streaming account queue.

entries.what: Works the swing shift, answering a few scanner calls while night pickers file in before the football game crowd.
entries.outcome: Cage down to a manageable pile.

entries.what: Eats Friday Taquería Colima takeout at her desk during shift.
entries.outcome: Good tacos, short line.

entries.what: Gets home after 10:30 with stadium noise from the Egrets opener fading, and plays a bit on her desktop.
entries.outcome: Bed around 1.

entries.what: Walks the Ulloa marsh boardwalk Saturday morning before studying.
entries.outcome: Easy walk, egrets out.

entries.what: Weekend study session with the tabbed study guide and practice-test app, working on subnetting.
entries.outcome: Scores still around the low 70s.

entries.what: Gets a car-repair quote for the O2 sensor and decides to book it in a couple of weeks.
entries.outcome: Plan to fix it later this month.

entries.what: Sunday late morning chores and laundry in the in-unit washer, then a grocery run with Iris.
entries.outcome: Fridge stocked for the week.

entries.what: Another study block, then Sunday night co-op game with her squad.
entries.outcome: Squad won a long run.

entries.what: Looks over the week ahead and thinks about booking the exam.
entries.outcome: Decides to look at test dates.
